Dear [Miss O’Meara](/person/1096)[^1]
Pray send me the story, though I can not answer, as you know[,] either for accepting it or being able soon to make use of it till I see it.

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Kathleen O\'Meara (1839-1888), a Catholic journalist and novelist of Irish birth who lived in France, contributed to MP in 1871-3.
[^2]: Envelope postmarked Winchester C Jy 21 83, addressed ‘Miss OMeara/15 Rue Washington/Paris’ the address struck through and another address given on the back.
